title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting transition still executes the unguarded update_reference_call_status — mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person is never wired and the race pin is vacuous
evidence:
form_handler.gleam apply_wrong_person: `case sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)` — update_reference_call_status.sql: `WHERE id = $1
  AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause); grep: mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person appears only in sql.gleam:1891 (definition) + the .sql file — zero production call sites; test: `wrong_person_awaiting_sql_has_taken_over_backstop_test` calls `rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)` directly, never handle_wrong_person_post.
detail: Both r4 mandate conditions fail: (1) the executed wrong-person awaiting UPDATE has no taken_over_at backstop, so a take-over between token read and UPDATE still yanks a landlord-handled row (take-over leaves status contact_initiated); (2) the pin calls the guarded SQL directly while the handler uses a different UPDATE — neutralizing it cannot catch the unwired path.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person's awaiting branch; rewrite the race pin to drive handle_wrong_person_post with do_take_over between read and POST and assert the row stays contact_initiated.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): N14 — Escape handler still on the menu div, unreachable in the natural click-⋯-then-Escape flow
evidence:
`True ->
  html.div(
    [
      attribute("data-testid", "refcheck-menu-" <> slot),
      attribute("role", "menu"),
      // r2 (N14): Escape closes the menu (the confirm_modal pattern).
      event.on(
        "keydown",
        menu_escape_decoder(msg.UserToggledRefcheckMenu(...))` — the menu div is a sibling of the ⋯ button; no tabindex/autofocus anywhere in view_overflow (grep: zero tabindex/autofocus in the file).
detail: Clicking ⋯ leaves focus on the button; keydown bubbles through ancestors, and the menu div is a sibling, not an ancestor — so Escape does nothing unless the user tabs into the menu. Unchanged between 111e221 and df0ea22.
recommended_fix: Move the keydown handler onto the ⋯ button (or autofocus the first menu item on open).
